orbi_leg_only_prompt:
Precise-object-edit. The supplied banner is the APPROVED Orbi design. The user explicitly loves the current pose and says to change NOTHING except the leg anatomy bug. This is a tiny local retouch, NOT a redesign.
LOCK AND REUSE every original pixel outside the pants/legs/shoes region: all title typography “Orbi”, “macOS AI 工作台”, pink underline, border, cream background, stars, little planets, motion strokes, pink fluffy Orbi planet, ring, satellite, the IP head/white hair/face/mask/eyes/earring/hoodie/arms/hands and waving gesture, lighting, shadows and composition must remain EXACTLY as supplied. Do not add, remove, move or recolor anything outside the two lower limbs.
Keep the IP SEATED on the pink orbital ring in exactly the same place with the same leaning torso, same raised waving hand, other hand resting on the ring, same original playful chibi proportions. Do not change to standing, walking or any other pose.
Retouch only the two gray trouser legs and sneakers below the seated pelvis: make two clearly separate natural continuous leg chains (hip → thigh → bent knee → calf → ankle → shoe). Keep the same general dangling leg directions and foot positions as the original; use minimal adjustments to resolve the tangled/fused knee and twisted ankle perspectives. The nearer shoe sole can face slightly toward the viewer as before; the farther shoe should connect naturally to its own shin. Exactly TWO thighs, TWO knees, TWO calves, TWO ankles and TWO shoes; no duplicate leg, merged pants limb, impossible bend, compressed lower leg or foot attached to the wrong knee. Maintain original gray hoodie/pants/sneakers material and scale; no colored clothing.
Output the same 3:1 banner framing, about 2172×724. Outside the localized trouser/leg/shoe retouch, treat the image as an immutable approved artwork. Preserve every other visual detail.

Give this knee a believable bend and enough transition into the shin; remove the detached-ball impression. This is a very minor local fabric/anatomy repair of this single leg only, not a redesign. Exactly two legs and two sneakers; no extra pants mass, extra knee or duplicate shoe.
